title: ticfac init always writes the PR + CI close-out rule; a repo without a GitHub origin then cannot run
description:
init.go:580-596 writes the forge-requiring close-out rule unconditionally, with no question or flag, and doctor never checks that origin parses as a GitHub remote. On a local-only or non-GitHub repo, pullRequestsForRun (forge.go:78-85) fails and the reconciler refuses to start, so init then run fails with nothing the operator can pass to fix it.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding e64e116aaa5b4347ef8e110464cf2aa3f482d59bf6bb27f5b5f8bc37833f2970 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/e64e116aaa5b4347ef8e110464cf2aa3f482d59bf6bb27f5b5f8bc37833f2970.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-09-27 16:09 - ticfac run epic-2jn: created by absorbing finding e64e116aaa5b4347ef8e110464cf2aa3f482d59bf6bb27f5b5f8bc37833f2970 — placed before the close-out, which does not start while it is open; the review had already run. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/e64e116aaa5b4347ef8e110464cf2aa3f482d59bf6bb27f5b5f8bc37833f2970.json on epic/2jn, and it says: no classifier prediction could be made — no classifier is configured for gating predictions — so the reporter's own claim decides: it breaks A1, and the finding is absorbed against that item. The claim is a prediction, scored later against what the done actually did
